blocks.prompt: 7. If \(2x,\ x + 8,\ 3x + 1\) are in A.P., then find the value of \(x\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan teen expressions \(x\) ke saath di hain aur kaha gaya hai ke yeh A.P. mein hain.
Find kya karna hai? \(x\) ki value.
Plan: teen terms A.P. mein hon to beech wali term ka dugna, baqi do terms ke jama ke barabar hota hai. Yehi equation bana kar solve karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(2x,\ x + 8,\ 3x + 1\) A.P. mein hain.
Humein find karna hai: \(x\).
Tareeqa: \(a, b, c\) A.P. mein hon to \(b - a = c - b\), yani \(2b = a + c\). Yeh shart (condition) is liye lagate hain ke is se ek seedhi si equation ban jati hai jis mein sirf \(x\) unknown hai.

A.P. wali shart likhein
\[2(x + 8) = 2x + (3x + 1)\]
Kyun: Beech wali term \(x + 8\) hai, us ka dugna left par; pehli aur teesri term \(2x\) aur \(3x + 1\) ka jama right par.
Dhyan dein: \(2(x + 8)\) mein bracket zaroori hai; \(2x + 8\) likhna ghalat hoga kyunke 2 poori term ko multiply karta hai.

\(x\) nikalein
\[2x + 16 = 5x + 1\]
\[15 = 3x\]
\[x = 5\]
Kyun: Bracket khola: \(2x + 16\). Right side par \(2x + 3x = 5x\). Phir \(2x\) ko right aur 1 ko left le gaye: \(16 - 1 = 5x - 2x\), yani \(15 = 3x\). Aakhir mein 3 se divide.

Tasdeeq
\[2x = 10,\quad x + 8 = 13,\quad 3x + 1 = 16\]
\[13 - 10 = 3,\quad 16 - 13 = 3 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(x = 5\) rakhne se terms 10, 13, 16 baneen, aur dono farq 3 hain. Barabar farq ka matlab A.P., to \(x = 5\) sahi hai.
